# Test fixtures

`observations_sample.xml` and `forecast_sample.xml` are subsets of the KAUR XML services
(<https://www.ilmateenistus.ee/ilma_andmed/xml/observations.php>,
<https://www.ilmateenistus.ee/ilma_andmed/xml/forecast.php>) as retrieved by the project owner
on 2026-11-13 (observations timestamp 1794556259 = 2026-11-13T07:50:59Z). Element structure is
unchanged; only some stations / places were left out and long free-text fields shortened.
Source: Keskkonnaagentuur, <https://www.ilmateenistus.ee>. Used only for parser tests.
